While crude petroleum and natural gas prices soared by 70.80%, primary food articles experienced only a slight inflation
issues.summary_100: In October, wholesale inflation in India surged to 12.29%, up from 11.39% in September. This increase was largely driven by a dramatic rise in fuel and power prices, which skyrocketed to 32.84%. Meanwhile, manufactured goods showed minor easing, resulting in a cumulative WPI inflation of 10.14% from April to October.
